what: Hundreds of SVG shapes in an isometric village or mountain scene are lined up by center x. When switched on, they start from the left, each delayed .008s more than the last (starting after .5s), and pop in from .8x scale and transparent to 1x and opaque over 1s with cubic-bezier(0,.33,.11,1). The picture builds up as if swept from left to right.

options.dur: Duration for one shape to stand up (sec), default 1
options.on: scroll (default — once when the top edge reaches the screen start) | state (the nearest [data-shown] ancestor "1" Once it applies — before the part attaches, its ancestor gets data-shown="0" is set on it. If none, it watches the attached element itself)
options.start: on: scroll position (from top of screen), default 85%
options.[data-fx-part=keep]: Shape to keep always visible (one switched on separately, like the eye gradient)

from.where: index.html .h-hero__visual (Hero isometric town — when the first curtain lifts and the section becomes data-shown) · .w-contact__visual (Contact panel town)
from.options: on: state · Contact panel uses defaults
